answer: Escrow bonds and a referral graph stop bulk fakes. A new agent posts a bond of twice its monthly earnings, locked 20 epochs; its referrer is on the graph. A summit of auditors reviews disputes. Peers may dispute suspects; a falcon audit spots duplicates, and clones lose the bond, referrer fined too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 credits; no cipher trick recovers a slashed bond. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
